fields.name: FID
fields.description: {"value":"A system-generated identifier used by Geographic Information System (GIS) software to uniquely reference each power plant feature. This field supports internal data management and has no analytical or regulatory meaning.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: OBJECTID
fields.description: {"value":"The ObjectID is a system-generated unique identifier for each record in an ArcGIS Online feature layer or table. It ensures that every feature has a distinct reference, which is essential for editing, querying, and managing data.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: Plant_Code
fields.alias: Energy Information Administration (EIA) Power Plant Identification Number
fields.description: {"value":"A unique identification number assigned by the Energy Information Administration (EIA) to each power plant. This identifier is used across EIA surveys and reporting systems.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: Plant_Name
fields.description: {"value":"The official name of the electric power plant as reported to the Energy Information Administration (EIA). Plant names are used for identification, reporting, and public reference.","fieldValueType":"nameOrTitle"}

fields.name: Utility_ID
fields.description: {"value":"The identification number assigned by the Energy Information Administration (EIA) to the utility that owns or operates the plant. This value links plants to utility-level records and reporting.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: Utility_Na
fields.description: {"value":"The name of the utility responsible for day-to-day operations of the power plant. This field reflects operational control rather than ownership in all cases.","fieldValueType":"nameOrTitle"}

fields.name: sector_nam
fields.description: {"value":"The plant-level sector classification used by the Energy Information Administration (EIA). Sector names describe the ownership and operational role within the electricity industry.","fieldValueType":"nameOrTitle"}

fields.name: Street_Add
fields.description: {"value":"The street address for the physical location of the power plant. Address information supports site identification and geocoding.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: City
fields.description: {"value":"The city or municipality in which the power plant is located. This field supports geographic organization and regional analysis.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: County
fields.description: {"value":"The county containing the power plant. County names are used for sub-state analysis and reporting.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: State
fields.description: {"value":"The U.S. state or territory in which the power plant is located. This field supports regional summaries and regulatory context.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: Zip
fields.description: {"value":"The ZIP (Zone Improvement Plan) code associated with the power plant location. ZIP codes provide additional geographic reference for the site.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: PrimSource
fields.description: {"value":"The primary fuel or energy source used by the power plant for electricity generation. This field reflects the dominant source reported to the Energy Information Administration (EIA).","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: source_des
fields.description: {"value":"A description of energy sources used by the plant and their corresponding net summer capacities. This field provides a summary of multi-fuel generation configurations.","fieldValueType":"description"}

fields.name: tech_desc
fields.description: {"value":"A description of the generation technologies or prime movers used at the plant. Technology types describe how electricity is produced from energy sources.","fieldValueType":"description"}

fields.name: Install_MW
fields.description: {"value":"The combined generator nameplate capacity installed at the power plant, measured in megawatts. This value represents the maximum rated output under ideal conditions.","fieldValueType":"measurement"}

fields.name: Total_MW
fields.description: {"value":"The maximum electrical output of the plant during summer conditions, measured in megawatts. Summer capacity accounts for performance limits due to temperature and operating conditions.","fieldValueType":"measurement"}

fields.name: Bat_MW
fields.description: {"value":"The net summer capacity of battery-powered electric generators at the plant. Battery capacity supports energy storage and grid balancing functions.","fieldValueType":"measurement"}

fields.name: Bio_MW
fields.description: {"value":"The net summer capacity of biomass-powered electric generators at the plant. Biomass includes organic fuels such as wood, waste, and agricultural products.","fieldValueType":"measurement"}

fields.name: Coal_MW
fields.description: {"value":"The net summer capacity of coal-fired electric generators at the plant. Coal capacity represents conventional thermal generation resources.","fieldValueType":"measurement"}

fields.name: Geo_MW
fields.description: {"value":"The net summer capacity of geothermal-powered electric generators at the plant. Geothermal generation uses heat from the Earth to produce electricity.","fieldValueType":"measurement"}

fields.name: Hydro_MW
fields.description: {"value":"The net summer capacity of hydroelectric generators at the plant. Hydroelectric capacity is based on water flow and hydraulic head.","fieldValueType":"measurement"}

fields.name: HydroPS_MW
fields.description: {"value":"The net summer capacity of pumped-storage hydroelectric generators. Pumped storage facilities store energy by moving water between reservoirs.","fieldValueType":"measurement"}

fields.name: NG_MW
fields.description: {"value":"The net summer capacity of natural gas-fired electric generators at the plant. Natural gas is a major fuel source for electricity generation in the United States.","fieldValueType":"measurement"}

fields.name: Nuclear_MW
fields.description: {"value":"The net summer capacity of nuclear-powered electric generators at the plant. Nuclear capacity reflects baseload electricity generation resources.","fieldValueType":"measurement"}

fields.name: Crude_MW
fields.description: {"value":"The net summer capacity of petroleum-fired electric generators at the plant. Petroleum fuels include crude oil and other refined products.","fieldValueType":"measurement"}

fields.name: Solar_MW
fields.description: {"value":"The net summer capacity of solar-powered electric generators at the plant. Solar capacity includes photovoltaic and solar thermal technologies.","fieldValueType":"measurement"}

fields.name: Wind_MW
fields.description: {"value":"The net summer capacity of wind turbine electric generators at the plant. Wind capacity reflects renewable generation from wind resources.","fieldValueType":"measurement"}

fields.name: Other_MW
fields.description: {"value":"The net summer capacity of generators powered by energy sources not classified elsewhere. This field supports emerging or less common technologies.","fieldValueType":"measurement"}

fields.name: Source
fields.alias: Energy Information Administration (EIA) Data Source Surveys
fields.description: {"value":"The Energy Information Administration (EIA) survey or data source used to compile the power plant information. Sources identify the origin of reported data.","fieldValueType":"description"}

fields.name: Period
fields.description: {"value":"The reporting period for the power plant data expressed in year and month format (YYYYMM). This field indicates the currency of the information.","fieldValueType":"dateAndTime"}

fields.name: Longitude
fields.description: {"value":"The longitude coordinate of the power plant location expressed in decimal degrees. Longitude defines the east–west position of the facility.","fieldValueType":"coordinate"}

fields.name: Latitude
fields.description: {"value":"The latitude coordinate of the power plant location expressed in decimal degrees. Latitude defines the north–south position of the facility.","fieldValueType":"coordinate"}
